procedures.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.topic_visible_post_count(p_topic_id integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.posts
   WHERE topic_id = p_topic_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE public.prune_read_notifications(IN p_days integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM public.notifications
   WHERE read AND created_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_days);
END;
$procedure$

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE public.begin_upload_snapshot(IN p_label text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_backup_start(p_label, true);
END;
$procedure$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER posts_bump_topic AFTER INSERT ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION posts_bump_topic()
